source: kohphangan.com party map (our sister site), checked Nov 2026

points.name: Haad Rin Nok (Sunrise Beach)
points.label: The party
points.desc: The main party beach, facing east. On the biggest nights up to about 30,000 people dance along the sand.

points.name: Tommy Resort
points.label: Dance · EDM · house
points.desc: One of the main stages at the north end, with the biggest sound and light rig on the beach and fire shows.

points.name: Cactus Bar
points.label: Live music · fire shows
points.desc: One of the most popular bars on the beach, with fire shows, fire limbo and live music.

points.name: Moonrise Beach Bar
points.label: DJ sets · performances
points.desc: A stage right on the sand with resident DJs and live performances, busy through the middle of the night.

points.name: Drop In Bar (DOP)
points.label: Commercial · EDM
points.desc: One of the oldest names on Haad Rin, playing big commercial and EDM tracks until about 04:00.

points.name: Paradise Bungalows
points.label: The original vibe
points.desc: At the south end of the beach, where the Full Moon Party began in the 1980s.

points.name: Disco Zoo Bar & Hostel
points.label: Bar · open late
points.desc: A bar and hostel just behind the beach, open late.

points.name: Haad Rin Nai (Sunset Beach)
points.label: Chill-out
points.desc: The quieter beach on the other side of the village, facing west towards Koh Samui.

points.name: Haad Rin Pier
points.label: Boats
points.desc: Ferries and speedboats to and from Koh Samui. Our shared boats include the pier fee.

points.name: Walking Street
points.label: Food · shops
points.desc: Food stalls, bars and shops on the way between the pier and the beach.

points.name: 7-Eleven, taxi meeting point
points.label: Taxis · 24 hours
points.desc: A 24-hour shop and the main meeting point for taxis.

points.name: ATM and money exchange
points.label: Cash · 24 hours
points.desc: ATM and money exchange, open 24 hours. Bring cash from Samui: queues are long on party night.

points.name: Haad Rin police booth
points.label: Police
points.desc: The first place to go for theft, accidents or emergencies on party night. Tourist Police: 1155.

points.name: Doctor Takecare Clinic
points.label: Clinic · 24 hours
points.desc: The closest clinic to the party, open 24 hours.

points.name: Ocean Medical Clinic
points.label: Clinic · until midnight
points.desc: Clinic in Haad Rin for wound care and other treatment, open until midnight.
